correctness.rationale: The target is a finite 243-by-81 exact incidence-cover instance. The 31 base-three indices form a covering code by direct enumeration of all 243 targets and each distinct one-deletion outcome. The unrelaxed 0-1 covering model has completed optimal integer objective 31 and a matching global solver lower bound, gap 0; the equivalent complementary 0-1 omission model has integer maximum 50 and matching global solver bound, gap 0. The supplied executable recomputes incidences by deletion, validates the complete witness and independently constructs both integer formulations; original replays examined 355 and 180 MILP nodes. Confidence requires trusting the correctly completed SciPy/HiGHS mixed-integer branch search, because its internal proof trace is not independently certified. No infinite-family extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: A natural exact finite invariant for synchronization-error covering, one codeword length beyond the known exact ternary predecessor, is determined in full. The construction and obstruction improve the elementary sphere lower bound 23 to exact 31 and provide an inspectable benchmark. The claim has precise independent motivation as a minimum subsequence-hitting set, without extrapolation to untested parameters or need for a downstream theorem.
